manualFollowUps: Content only: 200 original Digital SAT Reading and Writing questions (100 Information and Ideas, 100 Craft and Structure) for SAT Practice, generated by node scripts/content/sat-rw-a.mjs from content/sat-practice/information_and_ideas.json and craft_and_structure.json. No frontend, Edge Function, worker or secret changes.

Dependency: ship the sat-engine release (branch claude/sat-engine: SAT Practice app, sat-practice function and SQL RPCs that read sat_official_domain, sat_skill, passage, table and <u> underline markup) first, or together. Inserting these rows before the engine is live is backward compatible with the current selector (rows carry the legacy sat_domain values command_of_evidence and vocabulary_in_context and type question_single_choice), but the current UI may not render passages, tables or underlines, so do not push this migration ahead of the engine unless the coordinator accepts that.

Database (after the engine release): supabase db push --linked --include-all only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus these two 20261026142000/20261026142100 migrations, keeping the 9 pending payment migrations from #220 (20261010162000-20261010174000) and any other agents' unreviewed migrations excluded. Dry run first. Each migration first checks that the SAT Practice Reading and Writing section 2dd5a6ad-d4e5-5141-982e-22469816765f exists under experience d2f60197-eaa3-5772-88ac-b05d60f11bb5 (raises otherwise), then inserts one part (Information and Ideas display_order 10, Craft and Structure 11), 100 content_units and 100 answer_keys, all with plain on conflict do nothing.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows 20261026142000 and 20261026142100 applied and the 9 #220 payment migrations still pending.

select p.name, count(*) from public.content_units c join public.parts p on p.id=c.part_id where p.id in (md5('schood-sat-part:information_and_ideas')::uuid, md5('schood-sat-part:craft_and_structure')::uuid) group by 1 returns 100 for each part; every one of those content_units has an answer_keys row.

Signed in to practice.sat.schood.online, a Reading and Writing session filtered to Information and Ideas and to Craft and Structure serves the new items with passage, table (quantitative evidence items) and underline rendering, and answer keys stay hidden until scoring.

rollback.migration: Additive content only. If an item must be withdrawn, forward-fix in a new migration using the retirement mechanism the sat-engine selector honours (for example a content_status other than published); do not delete rows that learners may already have attempted.
